`interface AudioListenerPosition`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.video` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [AudioListenerPosition.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/video/AudioListenerPosition.java)

Gives the position of the listener that the sound of placed videos fades with.

## Description

Pass it as a lambda to [`VideoAudioPlayer.audioListenerPosition`](/reference/resources/videoaudioplayer/#VideoAudioPlayer-method-audioListenerPosition).

### getListenerPosition

`Point getListenerPosition()` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

JOID calls it on each draw of a video that has a location: return the position of the listener, in the same units as the location of the videos.
